name: cox2
description: Human cyclooxygenase-2 (PTGS2). BENCHMARK, not the research subject.
_targets_note: UniProt accessions -> short labels. Accessions are stable across ChEMBL releases; ChEMBL target IDs are not, so never hardcode those. Find yours at uniprot.org. The label becomes the output filename, so keep it short and filesystem-safe. Two accessions here means two datasets built side by side (e.g. an isoform pair). target_type is 'SINGLE PROTEIN' for a protein and 'ORGANISM' for a whole-organism MIC endpoint.

endpoint._note: Which measurement to model. Do NOT pool IC50 with Ki or Kd without checking the counts first — `census` prints them. Anything excluded here is counted and named in the curation log, so you never silently drop a whole endpoint.

cascade._note: ⚠️ For an ORGANISM target on the MIC path, set min_confidence_score to null and assay_type to null. Organism-level assays score low BY DESIGN, so reusing 8 silently deletes the entire dataset. This is the single most common way to repoint this pipeline and get nothing.

filter._note: REQUIRED. Set by you after running `census`. The pipeline refuses to build without it, because pooling assay formats stacks several different measurements under one column name.

label._note: 6.0 = 1 uM. Declared in advance, never fitted to results. This goes in the EF1% caption — without a stated cutoff an enrichment figure means nothing.

splits._note: Every split groups on inchikey, and a leakage guard exits non-zero if a compound lands on both sides. Format-held-out splits were REMOVED: this pipeline trains on one declared assay format and no longer re-tests that choice. Use --repeats N on the scaffold split for a reportable uncertainty — the default of 1 measures one arbitrary partition.

features._pharmacophore_note: Gobbi 2D pharmacophore signature: pairs and triplets of donor / acceptor / aromatic / hydrophobe / acidic / basic features binned by TOPOLOGICAL distance. 39,972 raw bits folded to folded_bits. No conformer and no stereochemistry required — that is the point, since a fifth of a natural-product library carries unspecified stereocentres. Only `folded_bits` is tunable; changing it changes the collision rate, reported in featurisation_report.md. Chirality does not appear here at all: a topological pharmacophore is blind to it by construction.
features._blocks_note: Which feature blocks enter the model. "both" (default) = pharmacophore signature + RDKit descriptors. "pharmacophore" = signature only. "descriptors" = descriptors only. Run the ablation with --blocks on train_model.py / train_classifier.py / screen.py rather than editing this; outputs are suffixed so runs cannot overwrite each other. It matters more than with a substructure fingerprint, because a molecule setting ZERO pharmacophore bits is carried entirely by its descriptors — check panel D of the characterisation figure.
features._note: Ipc is a product of graph-matrix eigenvalues and overflows float32 on larger molecules. NumUnspecifiedAtomStereoCenters is a CURATION artefact, not chemistry: the same molecule scores 2 drawn without stereo and 0 drawn with it, so it encodes how completely a record was annotated and lets the model learn which database a compound came from. NumAtomStereoCenters is KEPT — it counts centres that exist whether or not anyone drew them, which is a real structural property.

negative_controls._note: Shuffle the labels, refit, confirm the margin collapses to ~0. OECD validation principle 4. If a scrambled model still performs, the pipeline is leaking and every other number is void.

expected._note: Inter-laboratory agreement for IC50 (Kalliokoski 2013, PLoS ONE 8:e61007). An RMSE far below this is evidence of leakage, not skill. For MIC use ~0.3 log10, one doubling dilution.
